% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpPythonPlayground[src=/docs/components/_shared/intro-projects/python.json]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/python-playground/python-playground.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-python-playground");
element1.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/_shared/intro-projects/python.json");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Single source file
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpPythonPlayground[src=/docs/components/_shared/single-source/example.py]{}
\end{document}
